formula: first day of the month, parsed from the text column 'mois' (YYYY-MM)
business_meaning: Month of the observation.
research_value: Time axis of every trend and of the date-range filter.

formula: date formatted as YYYY-MM
business_meaning: Readable month label.
research_value: Used in tooltips and tables.

formula: INSEE region code, kept as text
business_meaning: Stable key of a region.
research_value: Join key between fact_energy, dim_region and the GeoJSON map.

formula: official region name looked up from region_code
business_meaning: Region name.
research_value: Same label in every table, chart and filter.

formula: region name as written in the source file
business_meaning: Original label, kept for traceability.
research_value: Shows that standardisation did not change the meaning of a region.

formula: short label from dim_region (ARA, BFC, IDF, ...)
business_meaning: Compact region label.
research_value: Readable labels on the map and in small multiples.

formula: year of date
business_meaning: Calendar year.
research_value: Before/after comparison 2014 vs 2025 and annual aggregation.

formula: month of date
business_meaning: Calendar month.
research_value: Seasonal profile of each source.

formula: quarter of date
business_meaning: Calendar quarter.
research_value: Coarser seasonal view for small multiples.

formula: winter = Dec-Feb, spring = Mar-May, summer = Jun-Aug, autumn = Sep-Nov
business_meaning: Meteorological season.
research_value: Solar peaks in summer, wind and hydro in winter and spring: comparing seasons avoids reading a seasonal swing as a trend.

formula: nuclear production of the region in the month, from the source file; negative values set to 0 in the feature dataset (raw value in cleaned_dataset, row flagged). NaN replaced by 0 in the regions that have no nuclear plant (structural zero).
business_meaning: Electricity produced from nuclear in one region and one month.
research_value: Raw material of all shares, growth rates and scores.

formula: thermal production of the region in the month, from the source file; negative values set to 0 in the feature dataset (raw value in cleaned_dataset, row flagged).
business_meaning: Electricity produced from thermal in one region and one month.
research_value: Raw material of all shares, growth rates and scores.

formula: hydro production of the region in the month, from the source file; negative values set to 0 in the feature dataset (raw value in cleaned_dataset, row flagged).
business_meaning: Electricity produced from hydro in one region and one month.
research_value: Raw material of all shares, growth rates and scores.

formula: wind production of the region in the month, from the source file; negative values set to 0 in the feature dataset (raw value in cleaned_dataset, row flagged).
business_meaning: Electricity produced from wind in one region and one month.
research_value: Raw material of all shares, growth rates and scores.

formula: solar production of the region in the month, from the source file; negative values set to 0 in the feature dataset (raw value in cleaned_dataset, row flagged).
business_meaning: Electricity produced from solar in one region and one month.
research_value: Raw material of all shares, growth rates and scores.

formula: bioenergy production of the region in the month, from the source file; negative values set to 0 in the feature dataset (raw value in cleaned_dataset, row flagged).
business_meaning: Electricity produced from bioenergy in one region and one month.
research_value: Raw material of all shares, growth rates and scores.

formula: nuclear + thermal + hydro + wind + solar + bioenergy
business_meaning: Total electricity produced in the region.
research_value: Denominator of every share; size of the regional system.

formula: hydro + wind + solar + bioenergy
business_meaning: All renewable production.
research_value: Headline KPI of the transition.

formula: wind + solar + bioenergy
business_meaning: Renewables without hydro.
research_value: Hydro is old and depends on rain: this isolates the part that is really growing.

formula: renewable_gwh / total_gwh x 100
business_meaning: Part of regional production that is renewable.
research_value: Main progress indicator for the research question.

formula: new_renewables_gwh / total_gwh x 100
business_meaning: Part of production from wind, solar and bioenergy.
research_value: Shows the transition without the hydro baseline.

formula: solar_gwh / total_gwh x 100
business_meaning: Part of regional production that comes from solar.
research_value: Links the dashboard to the solar story told in the introduction.

formula: wind_gwh / total_gwh x 100
business_meaning: Part of regional production that comes from wind.
research_value: Compares the wind regions with the solar regions.

formula: hydro_gwh / total_gwh x 100
business_meaning: Part of regional production that comes from hydro.
research_value: Shows how much of the renewable share is the historical hydro base.

formula: bioenergy_gwh / total_gwh x 100
business_meaning: Part of regional production that comes from bioenergy.
research_value: Small source, shown for completeness of the mix.

formula: nuclear_gwh / total_gwh x 100
business_meaning: Part of regional production that comes from nuclear.
research_value: Explains why regions without nuclear have a different starting point.

formula: thermal_gwh / total_gwh x 100
business_meaning: Part of regional production that comes from thermal (fossil).
research_value: Tracks the fossil part that the transition has to replace.

formula: (renewable_gwh + nuclear_gwh) / total_gwh x 100
business_meaning: Part of production that does not burn fossil fuel.
research_value: French context: separates 'renewable' from 'low carbon'.

formula: (total_gwh - total_gwh one month before) / total_gwh one month before x 100
business_meaning: Month-on-month change of total production.
research_value: Descriptive only: strongly seasonal, not used for conclusions.

formula: (total_gwh - same month one year before) / same month one year before x 100
business_meaning: Year-on-year change of total production.
research_value: Context: is the whole system growing or shrinking.

formula: (renewable_gwh - same month one year before) / same month one year before x 100
business_meaning: Year-on-year change of renewable production.
research_value: Speed of renewable growth, season removed. Empty when the base month is 0 or less; noisy when the base is small.

formula: (new_renewables_gwh - same month one year before) / same month one year before x 100
business_meaning: Year-on-year change of wind + solar + bioenergy production.
research_value: Speed of the real transition. Empty when the base month is 0 or less; noisy when the base is small.

formula: (solar_gwh - same month one year before) / same month one year before x 100
business_meaning: Year-on-year change of solar production.
research_value: How fast solar grows region by region. Empty when the base month is 0 or less; noisy when the base is small.

formula: (wind_gwh - same month one year before) / same month one year before x 100
business_meaning: Year-on-year change of wind production.
research_value: How fast wind grows region by region. Empty when the base month is 0 or less; noisy when the base is small.

formula: sum of renewable_gwh over the last 12 months of the region (empty before month 12)
business_meaning: Production of the last 12 months (renewable).
research_value: Removes seasonality; in December it equals the calendar year.

formula: sum of solar_gwh over the last 12 months of the region (empty before month 12)
business_meaning: Production of the last 12 months (solar).
research_value: Removes seasonality; in December it equals the calendar year.

formula: sum of wind_gwh over the last 12 months of the region (empty before month 12)
business_meaning: Production of the last 12 months (wind).
research_value: Removes seasonality; in December it equals the calendar year.

formula: sum of new_renewables_gwh over the last 12 months of the region (empty before month 12)
business_meaning: Production of the last 12 months (wind + solar + bioenergy).
research_value: Removes seasonality; in December it equals the calendar year.

formula: sum of total_gwh over the last 12 months of the region (empty before month 12)
business_meaning: Production of the last 12 months (total).
research_value: Removes seasonality; in December it equals the calendar year.

formula: rolling_12m_renewable / rolling_12m_total x 100
business_meaning: Smoothed share of renewable production.
research_value: Stable version of the share: base of the ranks and of the scores.

formula: rolling_12m_new_renewables / rolling_12m_total x 100
business_meaning: Smoothed share of wind + solar + bioenergy production.
research_value: Stable version of the share: base of the ranks and of the scores.

formula: rolling_12m_solar / rolling_12m_total x 100
business_meaning: Smoothed share of solar production.
research_value: Stable version of the share: base of the ranks and of the scores.

formula: rolling_12m_wind / rolling_12m_total x 100
business_meaning: Smoothed share of wind production.
research_value: Stable version of the share: base of the ranks and of the scores.

formula: sum of thermal_gwh over 12 months / rolling_12m_total x 100
business_meaning: Smoothed share of thermal production.
research_value: Base of the fossil dependency score.

formula: renewable_share_12m_pct - same value 12 months earlier
business_meaning: Progress of the renewable share during the last year.
research_value: Measures progress, not level: the right comparison between regions that start from different points.

formula: new_renewables_share_12m_pct - same value 12 months earlier
business_meaning: Progress of wind + solar + bioenergy during the last year.
research_value: Same idea, without the hydro baseline.

formula: rank of renewable_share_12m_pct among the 13 regions in the same month, 1 = highest (ties share the lowest rank)
business_meaning: Position of the region in the month.
research_value: Who leads the renewable transition, month after month.

formula: rank of solar_share_12m_pct among the 13 regions in the same month, 1 = highest (ties share the lowest rank)
business_meaning: Position of the region in the month.
research_value: Solar leaders and laggards.

formula: rank of wind_share_12m_pct among the 13 regions in the same month, 1 = highest (ties share the lowest rank)
business_meaning: Position of the region in the month.
research_value: Wind leaders and laggards.

formula: rank of renewable_share_gain_12m_pts among the 13 regions in the same month, 1 = highest (ties share the lowest rank)
business_meaning: Position of the region in the month.
research_value: Fastest progress of the last year (can differ from the level ranking).

formula: rank of renewable_share_12m_pct among the regions of the same group (with / without nuclear) in the same month
business_meaning: Position of the region among comparable regions.
research_value: Level of the renewable share mostly separates regions with and without nuclear; the peer rank compares like with like.

formula: (1 - sum of squared source shares) / (1 - 1/6), negative values set to 0
business_meaning: How balanced the monthly mix is: 0 = one source, 1 = six equal sources.
research_value: A diverse mix is less dependent on one technology.

formula: same formula on the 12-month sums of each source
business_meaning: Smoothed diversity of the mix.
research_value: Input of the transition score (no seasonal noise).

formula: renewable_share_12m_pct scaled between the 1st and 99th percentile of the dataset
business_meaning: Level component of the transition score.
research_value: Stored so the app can re-weight the score (what-if).

formula: new_renewables_share_12m_pct scaled the same way
business_meaning: Wind, solar and bioenergy component.
research_value: Rewards the part of the transition that is really new.

formula: 100 - fossil_dependency_score
business_meaning: Low use of thermal production.
research_value: Rewards regions that rely less on fossil generation.

formula: mix_diversity_12m scaled between the 1st and 99th percentile
business_meaning: Diversity component.
research_value: Rewards balanced mixes.

formula: 0.35 x score_renewable + 0.30 x score_new_renewables + 0.20 x score_fossil_free + 0.15 x score_diversity (weights in config.py)
business_meaning: One number for the state of the transition of a region (12-month basis, empty during the first 11 months).
research_value: Allows a ranking and a map with a single colour scale; weights can be changed in the what-if section.

formula: 50 + 50 x renewable_share_gain_12m_pts / bound, limited to 0-100 (bound = largest 1st/99th percentile)
business_meaning: Speed component on the renewable share.
research_value: 50 = no change, above 50 = progress.

formula: same formula on new_renewables_share_gain_12m_pts
business_meaning: Speed component on wind + solar + bioenergy.
research_value: Same reading, without hydro.

formula: 0.5 x momentum_renewable + 0.5 x momentum_new_renewables
business_meaning: Speed of the transition over the last 12 months (empty during the first 23 months).
research_value: Separates regions that are already high from regions that are moving fast.

formula: thermal_share_12m_pct scaled between the 1st and 99th percentile
business_meaning: Relative dependence on thermal (fossil) production.
research_value: The part of the system the transition has to replace.

formula: False if nuclear was never reported for the region (144 of 144 months empty)
business_meaning: Region with or without a nuclear plant.
research_value: Explains different starting points between regions.

formula: nuclear value was empty and replaced by 0
business_meaning: Row where nuclear = 0 comes from the cleaning rule.
research_value: Keeps the rule visible and reversible.

formula: at least one source has a negative value
business_meaning: Net production below zero in the month.
research_value: Lets the app annotate or exclude these rows.

formula: at least one source outside [Q1 - 3 x IQR, Q3 + 3 x IQR] computed on the region's own history
business_meaning: Unusual value compared with the region's own history.
research_value: Used to annotate charts, never to delete rows.

formula: a measure is still empty after cleaning
business_meaning: Real missing value.
research_value: Expected to be 0; kept as a safety net.

formula: list of the flags of the row separated by ';', or 'ok'
business_meaning: Readable summary of the row quality.
research_value: Filter and audit trail.
